feasibility.keyRisk: Preserve assimilated FP32 snapped-grid weights, tokenizer, pooling and normalization; avoid silently substituting base BGE or a different embedding space.
preserve: Query/document prompt semantics, max sequence length and tokenizer
requiredChecks: Convert original staged safetensors rather than pickle/ONNX copies
Compare vector dimensions, norms and cosine similarities vs staged checkpoint
Evaluate retrieval on same query/document corpus
Keep existing embedding index separate until re-embedding/migration decision

feasibility.keyRisk: Original-shape dense assimilated tensors are not custom HRR attention, but Gated-DeltaNet QKV/V-head reorder, MRoPE, tied embeddings and image tower must match exact shipped semantics. Native architecture support does not prove conversion fidelity.
preserve: Assimilated dense weights, not stock base download
linear_attn QKV layout and V-head ordering
Rope parameters and hybrid layer types
Vision weights/preprocessors; export validated projector separately
requiredChecks: Check safetensors index complete, all tensor names/shapes supported
Review flat QKV layout versus b11734 reorder implementation
Compare same-token logits/perplexity before and after conversion
Test text and image paths separately; do not advertise video/tools without tests
Do not claim external HRR gateway/memory features from plain converted weights

feasibility.keyRisk: Architecture is supported but packed MLX affine weights and per-layer2/3/4/6-bit allocations are not standard dense HF tensors. Inspected converter does not implement MLX-affine unpacking; cannot merely strip quantization config or rename files.
preserve: Per-tensor bits, group_size, affine scales/biases, embedding/output special bit allocations
Exact model names/shapes, rope/chat template and token IDs
requiredChecks: Review dequantizer with known MLX packing test vectors, including3bit and6bit
Compare sampled dequantized tensors against trusted MLX result without model-repo code
Compare pre/post-conversion logits/perplexity and bounded output
Measure peak conversion memory/disk; dequantized model may require~72GB plus staging/output overhead
